title: Prove, Don't Disclose: Verifiable CBAM Compliance Across Industrial Supply Chains Using Rules as Code and Zero-Knowledge Proofs
description:
The CBAM methodology encoded as executable, hash-identified rule bundles, with zero-knowledge proofs that a declared embedded-emissions figure is the correct output of the identified rules without disclosing activity data.

This release accompanies Kaimeter Working Paper 2026-01, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22740284.
